title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E08 — Opie's Ill-Gotten Gain
Opie gets straight A's on his report card, much to Andy's delight. But when Opie finds out that his teacher made an error, he cannot figure out how to tell the truth without disappointing his father.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E10 — Up in Barney's Room
Barney moves into the courthouse jail after his landlady evicts him. When he learns that she is planning to sell her home and marry someone she just met, Barney suspects that she is the victim of a con man.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E09 — A Date for Gomer
Thelma Lou refuses to go with Barney to the town's upcoming dance unless he gets her visiting cousin Mary Grace a date. Just when he and Barney are about to give up, Gomer appears.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E11 — Citizen's Arrest
Gomer makes a citizen's arrest of Barney for an illegal U-turn, the same violation Barney has ticketed him for, causing him to overreact and resign as deputy.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E12 — Opie and His Merry Men
Opie and his friends take their roles as Robin Hood's men seriously when they befriend a hobo.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E13 — Barney and the Cave Rescue
Barney organizes a rescue party when Andy and Helen become trapped in a cave after it collapses. Unbeknownst to Barney, the two have already escaped, but decide to go back into the cave to save him from becoming a laughingstock.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E14 — Andy and Opie's Pal
Opie becomes jealous when he thinks Andy likes Trey, his new best friend, more than him. Andy then decides to teach Opie a lesson in friendship.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E15 — Aunt Bee the Crusader
Aunt Bee organizes a protest to keep Mr Frisby, the local egg farmer, from getting evicted because of a highway project. However, unbeknownst to her, Mr Frisby is hiding a big secret.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E16 — Barney's Sidecar
Barney adds a vintage motorcycle to the rolling stock of the Mayberry Sheriff's Department.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E17 — My Fair Ernest T. Bass
A mountain-bred would-be Romeo is brought into Andy's home to be taught some manners.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E18 — Prisoner of Love
Andy and Barney fall for the charms of a female prisoner who threatens to crumble the security of the Mayberry jail.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E19 — Hot Rod Otis
Otis Campbell acquires a car and threatens the lives and limbs of Mayberry's pedestrian population.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E05 — Canadian Transplants Seek RV
Susan and Todd Cranford want to show off the U.S. to their children.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E06 — Full Time Travel Trailer
Travel nurse Jaci and her best friend Amanda look for a travel trailer that Jaci can live in full-time.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E07 — Cross-Country RV Adventure
Breana Evans and Robert Haley move into their RV full-time so they can live a more intrepid lifestyle.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E08 — RV For Trips With Grandkids
Phil and Mary get ready to take their family on the road with a Class C unit, easier to drive than other models, but still comfortable.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E09 — Upgrade For Family Of Five
Brian and Diane love vacationing with their family in their RV, and they look to invest in a larger, more comfortable unit.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E10 — Newlyweds Look For A New RV
Newlyweds Noëlle and Andrew are ready to take their work as health coaches on the road.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E11 — Young Couple Seeks A Class C
Adventure lovers Katie and Noah are shopping for a RV to take them around the United States.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E12 — Travel Trailer For Athletic Triathlons
Denise and Brian have loved camping their entire lives and plan to go full-time when Brian retires, so they are searching for an RV that will help them see places not accessible by airplane.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E13 — Trailer To Travel The US
Veterans Jennifer and Kory are ready to hit the road and explore every corner of the United States with their family in an RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S04 E14 — Fifth Wheel To Call Home
Kym and Kevin want to make the move out of Los Angeles and look for a large fifth wheel to call home.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E01 — First Time Full-Timers
An Atlanta family decides to try out RV living with hopes of simplifying their busy lives and spending more time with their kids.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E02 — Fifth-Wheel For Financial Firm
A young couple trades in their home for an RV while simultaneously growing a successful business.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E03 — Kid-Friendly Bunkhouse
A Georgia couple that wants to continue family traditions with their children looks to upgrade to an RV that meets everyone's needs.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E04 — Motorhome For Motorcycles
A couple with four children looks for a motorhome that can keep up with their on-the-go lifestyle.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E05 — Interim Rv Living
A family of five from Washington searches for a fifth-wheel to call home while they build their dream home; the couple hopes to find an RV with an open floor plan and separate master bedroom.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E06 — RV for Retirement
A couple goes on the lookout for a motor home to take on new adventures and enjoy the perks of retirement; an RV with a bath and a half, plenty of sleeping space and comfortable to drive.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E07 — Bunks For Brothers
A family of four, always on the go in their travel trailer, decide to upgrade to a newer, drivable RV with a bunkhouse for the kids, a roomy kitchen, easy maneuverability and plenty of sleeping space.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E08 — ATV Toy Hauler
A Nevada couple decides to buy an RV that will allow them to set up camp while going on ATV trips with friends; a toy hauler with dry camping capabilities, an open floor plan and an ATV garage.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E09 — Easing Into Camping
A Texas couple wants to spend more quality time with their daughters while easing them into outdoor adventures in an RV; a lightweight, easy-to-tow travel trailer.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E10 — New Priorities, New RV
After a recent health scare, a couple decides to make new priorities that include having fun and making memories while taking family trips in an RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E11 — Luxury On Wheels
A fun-loving couple tries to compromise on an RV upgrade that will cater to his rugged camping style and her glamorous camping style.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E12 — Fifth-Wheel For Fifty States
A couple hopes to find the perfect RV that will help them achieve their goal of visiting all 50 states.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E13 — RV For Horse Shows
Caitlin and Sam swap out hotel rooms for a well-equipped RV.

title: Going RV
description:
S05 E14 — Bear-Proof RV
Rod and Camille want to provide their young sons with more outdoor adventures, so they are looking for their very first RV to take on camping trips.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E01 — Full-Time RV For Vegas Couple
After a scary four-wheeler accident, a Las Vegas couple reevaluates what they really want in their RV home life; they search for a rig with more room for their granddaughter, plenty of exterior storage space and a bigger kitchen and shower.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E02 — His Toy Hauler or Her Bunkhouse
Kari and her husband, Jose, search for their first travel trailer, hoping to give their young daughter happy camping memories; however, the couple must decide between his toy hauler and her bunkhouse.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E03 — Travel Trailer To Motorhome
A New Jersey couple looks for their third recreational vehicle as they transition from a travel trailer to a motor home; their wish list includes a residential refrigerator, large bunks, an outdoor entertainment center, and more storage.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E04 — RV for More Family Time
TJ and Alysha decide to sell everything and move into a recreational vehicle so they can spend more time with family; while they can't agree on a floor plan, they both want a bunkhouse, two couches, a large refrigerator, and lots of storage.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E05 — Sleeping for 10
After adopting their three nieces and increasing their family size from seven to 10, a couple search for a motor home that can accommodate their large family; at the top of their wish list is two bathrooms, a large fridge and a lot of storage.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E07 — Class A for a Sporty Family
A couple with a $255,000 budget search for a luxurious Class A motor home for their sporty family's adventures; the wish list includes a king-size bed, a bunkhouse and an engine with at least 450 horsepower.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E08 — An RV With Elbow Room
A couple with a $40,000 budget searches for a fifth wheel to accommodate their growing sons; their wish list includes more elbowroom, a private master bedroom and a bunkhouse.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E06 — Mother and Daughter RV
A retired mother-daughter duo looks for a new Class A diesel motor home to live in together full-time; with a budget of $400,000, they hope to find a home with a traditional oven and separate sleeping areas.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E09 — Anniversary Gift
A New York couple looks to upgrade their motor home for their 10-year anniversary; with a budget of $25,000, they hope to get everything at the top of their wish list, including an outdoor kitchen and space for their dog.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E10 — Bigger and Better
An Indiana couple looks for a new motor home for their family of four; with a budget of $40,000, they hope to find a recreational vehicle that's under 40 feet and has a large shower.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E11 — The RV Tradition
A Georgia couple searches for an easy-to-drive motor home to continue the tradition of RV camping with their daughters; with a $150,000 budget, their wish list includes two air conditioning units, a king-size bed and bunk beds.

title: Going RV
description:
S06 E12 — RV for Six
With a $200,000 budget, the Bramer family searches for a new Class A motor home; after traveling across the Alaskan frontier, the family is ready to hit the road in the continental United States; he wants a fifth-wheel, while she wants a Toy Hauler.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E20 — The Song Festers
Choir director John Masters decides to give Gomer the solo in the upcoming concert instead of Barney. Gomer fakes laryngitis when he learns how important the part is to Barney.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E21 — The Shoplifters
Barney disguises himself as a dummy in an attempt to solve a series of thefts in a Mayberry department store.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E22 — Andy's Vacation
Andy goes on vacation, leaving Barney and Gomer in charge of Mayberry. However, Andy cannot enjoy his rest as Barney and various townspeople interrupt his peace.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E23 — Andy Saves Gomer
Gomer believes that Andy has saved his life after Andy wakes him to put out a small fire at the filling station. Indebted, Gomer dedicates himself to repaying Andy in return.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E24 — Bargain Day
Aunt Bee buys a side of beef from a discount butcher shop to save money. When she gets home, she discovers that her bargain freezer does not work.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E25 — Divorce, Mountain Style
Charlene Darling-Wash wants to perform a mountain ritual to divorce Dud Wash and marry Andy. When Barney discovers a way to counteract the ritual with another ritual, Andy decides to fight fire with fire.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E26 — A Deal Is a Deal
Opie and his friends become involved in a scheme selling worthless salve. Barney and Gomer disguise themselves and head to Mount Pilot to fool two salve cons into buying all their salve back.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E27 — Fun Girls
Two fun-loving girls from Mount Pilot interrupt Andy and Barney, who are working late doing inventory. They end up in hot water when Helen and Thelma Lou see them with the other girls.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E28 — Return of Malcolm Merriweather
Aunt Bee feels unneeded when Malcolm Merriweather returns to Mayberry and gets enlisted to help at the Taylor House to give Aunt Bee a break from work.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E29 — The Rumor
Barney sees Andy and Helen sneaking a kiss in the jewelry store and tells everyone they are engaged. Aunt Bee redecorates Andy's room to make it more appropriate for a bride and throws a surprise party for them.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E30 — Barney and Thelma Lou, Phfftt
Thelma Lou uses Gomer and flirts with him to make Barney jealous after he says that he has her in his hip pocket. Things escalate when she slips and kisses Gomer on the cheek.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E31 — Back to Nature
Andy, Barney, and Gomer take Opie and a couple of his friends on a camping trip. When Opie leaves early in the morning to pick berries, Barney and Gomer go looking for him but end up getting lost in the woods.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E07 — All Systems Go
The start of farming season raises tension.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E08 — Lisa's Kitchen Crusade
Lisa develops a simple menu for their new kitchen.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E09 — Swapping Roles
Dan is sent off for work as the utility man.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E10 — Spread Thin
The King's home market opening; a series of mishaps with the new livestock.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E11 — King Marketing
Joe plans for next year's Freedom Farm Calendar.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E12 — Dinner With the Kings
Stress levels become high at the Garden Show setup; Joe is caught in a tight spot.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S02 E13 — King Calendar
Freedom Farms calendar photo shoot.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E01 — King's Fair Share
A new harvest season begins; local fair competitions.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E02 — Meat and Greet
Freedom Farms pulled pork by a mobile smoker.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E03 — Big Losses, Bigger Gains
A month-long fitness competition to inspire the customers.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E04 — Pete's Carving Calamity
Converting the land into an ag-entertainment mecca with CSA customers in the fields.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E05 — Ponds and Pavilions
Getting ready for the festival in a few short weeks.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E06 — Buried Treasure
An underground tree house allows farming year round.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E07 — Every King for Himself
Dan tries out a spot on a local radio station.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S03 E08 — Gimme Shelter!
A disaster bunker is put in order.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S04 E01 — Odd King Out
Assessing the state of Freedom Farms; the new Sandwich Shop; Lisa goes behind her son's back.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S04 E02 — Farmers in the City
A call from a NYC modeling agency for Pete and Dan to do a photo shoot.

title: Farm Kings
description:
S04 E03 — Unwelcome Home
Dan moves out on his own; Joe is left high and dry at the Home Market.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S04 E32 — Gomer Pyle USMC
Gomer enlists and joins the Marines to test himself as a man, with Andy driving him to the base for his first day at boot camp. When Andy learns that the sergeant plans to get Gomer home, he tries to prevent Gomer from getting kicked out.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E01 — Opie Loves Helen
Opie has a crush on his teacher, who is also Andy's girlfriend.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E02 — Barney's Physical
Andy and Aunt Bee help Barney reach the new civil service height and weight requirements so that he can keep his job.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E03 — Family Visit
Andy's patience is tried when the Taylors are visited by relatives.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E04 — The Education of Ernest T. Bass
Ernest T. Bass returns to Mayberry to get his diploma and falls in love with Helen, the town's elementary school teacher and Andy's girlfriend.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E05 — Aunt Bee's Romance
Aunt Bee's former beau, Roger Hanover, pays her a visit and begins courting her again. Andy and Opie soon become annoyed at Roger's bad jokes and gags.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E06 — Barney's Bloodhound
Barney tries to train Blue, a bloodhound, to track criminals. His plan backfires when he leads Blue to a criminal and the dog starts obeying him instead of Barney.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E07 — Man in the Middle
Barney and Thelma Lou have an argument. When Andy tries to console Barney, it leads to a parade of other arguments among Andy, Barney, Thelma Lou and Helen.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E08 — Barney's Uniform
Barney starts wearing his uniform all the time after a tough guy threatens to beat him up if he catches Barney out of uniform.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E09 — Opie's Fortune
Opie finds a purse containing $50, but Andy tells him that the money will only be his if no one claims it within a week. Soon, Opie gets the money but has to return it.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E10 — Goodbye, Sheriff Taylor
Andy lets Barney take over as sheriff for a day when he goes to Raleigh to attend a job interview. By the time he returns, Barney has turned the whole town upside down.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E11 — The Pageant
Aunt Bee gets the leading role in Mayberry's Centennial Pageant when Clara is suddenly called out of town. However, Aunt Bee is a terrible actress, causing her to get kicked out at her first rehearsal.

title: Love Can Surprise You
description: Despite her professional expertise, a relationship columnist discovers love does not come easy when forced to partner with a new writer in the love and romance section.
